hooks.command: sh -c 'R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || R="$PWD"; A="$R/scripts/hooks/guard-dispatch.ts"; B="$R/node_modules/@modfolio/harness/scripts/hooks/guard-dispatch.ts"; G=""; [ -f "$A" ] && G="$A"; [ -z "$G" ] && [ -f "$B" ] && G="$B"; [ -z "$G" ] && exit 0; BUN=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BUN" ] && [ -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] && BUN="$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; [ -z "$BUN" ] && { echo "[modfolio] bun 없음 — 이 호출은 미검사" >&2; exit 0; }; exec "$BUN" "$G"'
